sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vijay Kumar Tewari Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Sanjay Tripathi Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Shri Vijay Kumar Tewari, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Standing counsel appearing for the respondent No.1 and Shri Sanjay Tripathi, learned counsel for the respondent No.2.
2.

This petition has been filed by eight petitioners, who are resident of Village-Jalalpur, Pargana- Pasgawa, Tehsil- Mohammdi and District- Lakhimpur Kheri with the following main prayers:-
" 1. To issue writ, order or direction in the form of mandamus whereby, directing the Competent Authority/District Jand Acquisition Officer, Collectorate Compound,
Lakhimpur- Kheri (Opposite Party No. 1) to declare a fresh award as per the Ram Chandra And 7 Others vs Competent Authority/District Land ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82915140/
1 provisions Section-24 of The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No. 30 of 2013) in respect of the petitioners land, bearing Khasra No. 240. having an area of 0.2250 Hectare (Aabaadi Land) of the Village Jalalpur, Paragana: Pasgawa, Tehsil:
Mohammdi and District:- Lakhimpur- Kheri, as per the area depicted/shown in the Joint Measurement Survey (J.M.S) which is annexed with this writ petition as Annexure No. 2 and further to disburse the compensation to the petitioners along with solatium and other interests and benefits as to which the petitioners are rightly entitled.
II.

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No. 30 of 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: That further, to direct the Competent Authority and the National Highway Authority of India, to pay the Solatium and Interest of 12 years, on the Compensation of the demolish Construction standing on such land, That the petitioners received the compensation of the demolish construction standing on such aabadi land, after 12 years, therefore, petitioners are rightly entitled for the Interest and Solatium of 12 years that commence, from the date of Notification under Section3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 dated 16.11.2009, to the date of payment of compensation of demolish construction(i.e. dated 25.02.2022), to the petitioners, as per the Land Acqusition Act, 1894 and as well as, per the provisions of the New Act, 2013."

3. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that a notification was issued under Section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 for acquisition of certain land situated in Village-Jalalpur for widening of National Highway No.24 on 16.11.2009.

A notification under Section 3D of the National Highway Act, 1956 was then issued on 25.05.2010 and the award was passed by the respondent No.1 on 13.09.2013 without declaring compensation for Abaadi Land.
No award in respect of Khasra No.240, which is the land on which the petitioners' construction was situated has been made and no compensation has been paid.
The petitioners have approached the respondent No.1 on numerous occasions but only false assurance has been given.

The petitioners'
land was old Abaddi Land of the village and the constructions of the petitioners are existing since time of U.P. Z.A. L.R. Act, 1950.

They are poor farmers and their only source of livelihood is the land on which such construction was situated has been acquired for widening of National Highway No.24 without giving them any compensation.
Hence, the instant petition has been filed with the aforesaid prayers.
4. This Court has gone through the pleadings on record and heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.

From the pleadings on record, it is evident that the award was initially declared in the year 2013 and the petitioners have been given compensation for construction situated on Khasra/Gata No.240 of Rs.20,00,000/- and all of which has been paid on 25.03.2022.
The petitioners now want compensation to be given to them of land on which such construction was situated.

5. We have gone through the award and also CH- 41 and CH- 45 which the learned counsel for the petitioner has pointed out to us, which relates to old Gata No.240 with new number being declared as No.250, which is the land assigned for agriculture and not Gata No.240, which is the government Ram Chandra And 7 Others vs Competent Authority/District Land ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82915140/
2 land given as Abaadi.

entities.text: government Ram Chandra And 7 Others vs Competent Authority/District Land
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioners could not convince this Court that their construction have been standing since 1950 i.e. since the time of Zamindari Abolition and they are entitled for settlement of such land on which such construction is situated as their land under Section 9 of U.P.
Z.A. L.R. Act, 1950.

6. It is evident that the petitioners' construction was situated on Abaadi Land which was government land and it has been resumed and no compensation for the same can be given to the private persons like the petitioners.
The construction standing on it has been evaluated and compensation has already been given.
7. This Court finds no good ground to interfere in this matter.
8. In view thereof, the instant petition is dismissed.

. 
[Subhash Vidyarthi,J.]

[Sangeeta Chandra,J.] Order Date :- 15.4.2024 -Amit K-
